newsitem.title: USA: ConAgra food inputs up on grain merchandising.
newsitem.headline: ConAgra food inputs up on grain merchandising.

text.p: ConAgra Inc said Thursday its food inputs and ingredients segment saw a 20 percent rise in operating profits in the fiscal first quarter, thanks to grain merchandising.
Sales in this segment gained one percent compared with a year ago. Excluding previous business dispositions, segment sales rose nearly five percent.

ConAgra said grain merchandising was the largest source of operating profit growth for food inputs. Flour milling, European processing operations, the dry edible beans business, commodity services and specialty retailing also contributed meaningfully to segment profit growth.
Crop input earnings declined as weather conditions delayed planting and deferred sales of crop protection chemicals and fertilizer to the second quarter, ConAgra said.
Earlier, ConAgra reported first quarter earnings of $0.42 a share, up from $0.36 a year ago.

The year-ago first quarter included $5.1 million in preferred dividends, compared with no preferred dividends in the current quarter. ConAgra said the reduction of the preferred dividends was approximately offset by the expense of financing the class E preferred stock redemption.
